policies.summary: Permendikbud 44/2012 prohibits government-run basic-education units (SD/SMP negeri) from levying 'biaya satuan pendidikan' (pungutan); voluntary 'sumbangan' remain allowed (Pasal 12).
policies.status_as_of_2026: Regulation text verified; whether it is still in force unamended as of 2026 needs verification (not checked against JDIH).
policies.verbatim: Pasal 9 (1) Satuan pendidikan dasar yang diselenggarakan oleh Pemerintah, dan/atau pemerintah daerah dilarang memungut biaya satuan pendidikan.

source.title: Permendikbud Nomor 44 Tahun 2012 tentang Pungutan dan Sumbangan Biaya Pendidikan pada Satuan Pendidikan Dasar (Berita Negara RI 2012 No. 665)
source.publisher: Kemendikbud (copy hosted by Disdikbud Kabupaten Batang)
source.note: Ditetapkan 28 Juni 2012, diundangkan 29 Juni 2012.

policies.related_verbatim: Pasal 12 (1) Masyarakat di luar penyelenggara dan satuan pendidikan dasar yang didirikan masyarakat, serta peserta didik atau orang tua/walinya dapat memberikan sumbangan pendidikan kepada satuan pendidikan dasar.

policies.summary: UU 20/2003 (Sisdiknas) Pasal 34 ayat (2) is the statutory basis for fee-free compulsory basic education; as conditionally reinterpreted by the Constitutional Court (27 May 2025) it covers both government-run and community-run (private) basic-education units.
policies.status_as_of_2026: Binding reinterpretation in force since the ruling; implementation for private schools contested (see mk_ruling entries).
policies.verbatim: Menyatakan Pasal 34 ayat (2) Undang-Undang Nomor 20 Tahun 2003 tentang Sistem Pendidikan Nasional bertentangan dengan Undang-Undang Dasar Negara Republik Indonesia Tahun 1945 dan tidak mempunyai kekuatan hukum mengikat secara bersyarat sepanjang tidak dimaknai ‘Pemerintah dan Pemerintah Daerah menjamin terselenggaranya wajib belajar minimal pada jenjang pendidikan dasar tanpa memungut biaya, baik untuk satuan pendidikan dasar yang diselenggarakan oleh pemerintah maupun satuan pendidikan dasar yang diselenggarakan oleh masyarakat,

source.title: Diambil MBG, Putusan MK soal Sekolah Gratis Belum Dilaksanakan Pemerintah

policies.summary: BOS operational funding for 2025/2026 is governed by Permendikdasmen Nomor 8 Tahun 2025 (Juknis Pengelolaan Dana BOSP). Only the title was seen; the text was not accessed.
policies.status_as_of_2026: Needs verification (BPK JDIH PDF returned HTTP 403).
policies.verbatim: PERATURAN MENTERI PENDIDIKAN DASAR DAN MENENGAH REPUBLIK INDONESIA NOMOR 8 TAHUN 2025 TENTANG PETUNJUK TEKNIS PENGELOLAAN DANA BANTUAN OPERASIONAL SATUAN PENDIDIKAN

policies.summary: Constitutional Court Decision No. 3/PUU-XXII/2024 (read 27 May 2025, petition by JPPI and three mothers) requires central and regional government to guarantee fee-free compulsory basic education (SD/SMP/madrasah) in both public and private schools; private schools may still collect funds per regulations and state aid goes to private schools meeting conditions.
policies.status_as_of_2026: See the implementation entries: DPR Komisi X said (Jul 2025) phased implementation from 2026, full coverage around 2027-2028 (estimate); in May 2026 JPPI said it had not been implemented.
policies.verbatim: Mendikdasmen Abdul Mu’ti menyebut dirinya menunggu arahan Presiden Prabowo Subianto, dan hasil koordinasi bersama Kementerian Keuangan untuk menindaklanjuti Putusan MK Nomor 3/PUU-XXII/2024 yang dibacakan oleh majelis hakim pada 27 Mei 2025.

source.title: Menkeu pelajari putusan MK soal sekolah gratis negeri, swasta

policies.related_verbatim: MK menegaskan sekolah swasta tetap dapat membiayai pendidikan dari peserta didik atau sumber lain sesuai aturan yang berlaku. Namun, bantuan pendidikan dari pemerintah hanya diberikan kepada sekolah swasta yang memenuhi syarat tertentu.

related_source.title: Diambil MBG, Putusan MK soal Sekolah Gratis Belum Dilaksanakan Pemerintah

policies.summary: Implementation plan (July 2025): DPR Komisi X member Lalu Hadrian said Kemendikdasmen agreed to implement and budget from 2026, phased for selected schools, with full coverage estimated at 2027-2028 and cost around Rp181 trillion (his estimate).
policies.status_as_of_2026: Plan statement from July 2025; actual 2026 rollout scope not verified.
policies.verbatim: Lalu mengatakan keputusan itu telah disepakati pihaknya dalam rapat dengan Kementerian Pendidikan Dasar dan Menengah (Kemendikdasmen) beberapa waktu lalu. [...] Namun Lalu menyebut program tersebut akan diberlakukan secara bertahap hanya untuk beberapa sekolah. [...] Dia memperkirakan program itu akan diberlakukan secara total di semua wilayah pada 2027-2028.

source.title: DPR: Putusan MK Soal SD-SMP Swasta Gratis Berlaku 2026 Secara Bertahap

policies.summary: Status claim (May 2026): JPPI coordinator Ubaid Matraji (one of the petitioners) said central and regional governments had not implemented the ruling one year on, and criticised funding of MBG from the education budget. This is an advocacy group's claim, not an official status report.
policies.status_as_of_2026: Contested: per JPPI (26 May 2026) not implemented; no official 2026 government implementation report was verified.
policies.verbatim: Salah satu Pemohon dari Jaringan Pemantau Pendidikan Indonesia (JPPI), Ubaid Matraji menerangkan, pemerintah baik pusat maupun daerah nyatanya belum melaksanakan putusan tersebut sedari setahun yang lalu.

source.title: Diambil MBG, Putusan MK soal Sekolah Gratis Belum Dilaksanakan Pemerintah

policies.summary: Governor Dedi Mulyadi says free education (no SPP) for SMA/SMK negeri in Jawa Barat started in school year 2025/2026, and in July 2026 he rejected proposals from some Disdik branch offices (KCD) to Komisi V DPRD to reactivate SPP, arguing BOS plus provincial operational funds suffice.
policies.status_as_of_2026: As of July 2026: SPP not reinstated; governor publicly rejects reactivation for SMA/SMK negeri.
policies.verbatim: Dedi mengingatkan bahwa kebijakan pendidikan gratis bagi siswa SMA dan SMK negeri di Jawa Barat baru mulai diberlakukan pada tahun ajaran 2025/2026. [...] Pernyataan tersebut sekaligus merespons usulan reaktivasi SPP di SMA dan SMK negeri yang sebelumnya disampaikan sejumlah Kantor Cabang Dinas Pendidikan Provinsi Jawa Barat kepada Komisi V DPRD Jawa Barat.

source.title: Dedi Mulyadi Ungkap Dugaan Penyalahgunaan Dana BOS Rp 4 Miliar, Tolak SPP SMA-SMK Negeri

policies.summary: Disdik Jabar circular SE Nomor 32283/PK.02.01.04/SEKRE on financing rules for school year 2026/2027: SMA/SMK/SLB negeri may not discuss, offer, set or collect any payment from parents at re-registration (SPMB 2026); it also prohibits selling uniforms/books and threatens sanctions.

gaps: BPS websites (bps.go.id, depokkota.bps.go.id, bogorkota.bps.go.id statistics tables and press releases) returned Cloudflare HTTP 403 to both curl and WebFetch. National headline figures therefore come from Bank Indonesia's Data Inflasi table; group figures come from news media quoting BPS; Depok/Bogor figures come from BPS PDFs downloadable via web-api.bps.go.id.

National education group, Dec 2019: not recorded. Under the 2012=100 base the group was 'Pendidikan, Rekreasi, dan Olahraga', which is not comparable with later years. The Kemendag Satu Data table (satudata.kemendag.go.id, 'Inflasi Menurut Kelompok Pengeluaran, 1990-2019') lists 2019 values, but its column alignment looks inconsistent: the only negative Dec-2019 monthly value sits under 'Kesehatan', while search results said the education-recreation-sport group was the one that fell in Dec 2019. So no value was taken.

National education group, Dec 2021 (y-on-y): not found. The Dec-2021 BPS release text focused on month-to-month change, and search-engine summaries confused the month-to-month 'tidak mengalami perubahan' with the yearly figure.

National education group, July and August 2026 (y-on-y): not found; the latest found is June 2026 (1.27%). Bloomberg Technoz (2026-08-03) reports 'Kelompok pendidikan mengalami inflasi 0,55%' for July 2026 in a monthly-inflation context without labelling the measure, so it was not recorded.
Kota Depok: education group Dec 2025 not found; Dec 2025 headline (2.51%) is search-snippet only. Depok 2019-2021 not researched (fetch budget).
Kota Bogor: education group Dec 2023 and Dec 2024 not found; 2019-2022 not researched. A guessed Bapperida Kota Bogor URL for the Dec 2024 BRS returned 404.

MK ruling 3/PUU-XXII/2024: no official 2026 government report on implementation (e.g. which private SD/SMP became fee-free in 2026/2027, or the budget actually spent) was verified. The only 2026 status found is the petitioner JPPI's claim (May 2026) that the ruling has not been implemented. mkri.id returned 403.

Jabar SMA/SMK negeri: the SE Gubernur number differs between sources (43/PK.03.04/KESRA per Kompas, May 2025, vs 45/PK.03.03/KESRA per Tribun Jabar, July 2026); it may be a different or updated circular. The fee arrangements (IPP/SPP/iuran komite) before 2025/2026 and any provincial regulation (Pergub) behind 'sekolah gratis' were not verified.
Permendikbud 44/2012 current in-force status and the Permendikdasmen 8/2025 (Juknis BOSP) text were not verified (peraturan.bpk.go.id returned 403).
LPS guarantee rate for the period starting 1 Oct 2026 (normally set at the late-September RDK) was not found; needs live verification.
The 10-year SBN yield comes from Trading Economics (an aggregator); no DJPPR/BI/PHEI primary benchmark yield was obtained.

Education cost inflation estimates found (10-15%, 15-20% per year) come from bank or insurer marketing content and a media article with no stated method. No bank-research or government source giving a method-based estimate of education cost inflation was found.

method_note: Every value with evidence 'curl_verbatim' was grep-checked against the locally saved page/PDF text (macro_tmp/*.txt) by build_macro.py. Evidence 'search_snippet_only' means the page could not be opened. No statistic was computed, rounded or inferred; base-year labels are metadata.
